title: BEST OP FULL AUTO FARM  INSTANT KILL

+ Auto Farm (Attacks Brainrots with selected Gear)
+ Auto Plant (Selected Seeds)
+ Auto Plant Best Seed (Smartly manages plot space)
+ Auto Pickup Worst Plant (Replaces lowest value plant for better ones)
+ Auto Buy Best Seed (Ignores selected seeds)
+ Auto Buy Best Gear (Ignores selected gears)
+ Auto Buy Specific Seed
+ Auto Buy Specific Gear
+ Auto Equip Best Brainrots (Periodically equips your best brainrots)
+ Auto Sell All (with interval)

    + Favorite Plants by Mutation
+ Auto Rebirth (When requirements are met)
+ Auto Buy Rows
+ Auto Buy Platforms
+ Collect All Plants (Button)
